title: Unauthorized access attempt
content: Frequent permission denied, unauthorized, or forbidden events across protected resources.
advice: 核查访问边界、防护规则与账号权限配置，确认是否存在越权访问。
advice_cn: 核查访问边界、防护规则与账号权限配置，确认是否存在越权访问。
advice_en: Review access policy boundaries and account permissions.

title: SQL injection pattern
content: Request parameters include union select, or 1=1, sleep and similar SQL injection payloads.
advice: 启用 WAF 与参数化查询，并结合数据库错误日志核查是否存在注入探测或利用。
advice_cn: 启用 WAF 与参数化查询，并结合数据库错误日志核查是否存在注入探测或利用。
advice_en: Enable WAF and parameterized queries, audit DB error logs.

title: XSS injection pattern
content: Request contains script tag or onerror/onload style script injection patterns.
advice: 实施输出编码与 CSP 策略，并加强输入校验，排查受影响页面模板。
advice_cn: 实施输出编码与 CSP 策略，并加强输入校验，排查受影响页面模板。
advice_en: Apply output encoding and CSP, strengthen input validation.

title: Privilege escalation activity
content: Frequent sudo, su, or root transitions with sensitive command execution.
advice: 落实最小权限原则，审计 sudoers、特权组成员与高危命令链。
advice_cn: 落实最小权限原则，审计 sudoers、特权组成员与高危命令链。
advice_en: Apply least privilege and audit sudoers and command chains.

title: HDFS block transfer interruption
content: Connection reset by peer or broken pipe during block transfer.
advice: 检查网络稳定性与 DataNode 链路健康状态。
advice_cn: 检查网络稳定性与 DataNode 链路健康状态。
advice_en: Check network stability and DataNode link health.

title: HDFS replication timeout
content: PendingReplicationMonitor timed out blocks and replication lag increased.
advice: 检查副本队列、复制压力与集群负载均衡情况。
advice_cn: 检查副本队列、复制压力与集群负载均衡情况。
advice_en: Inspect replication queue and cluster load balance.

title: DataNode IO stream exception
content: IOException while receiving or writing HDFS blocks.
advice: 审计磁盘 IO 压力与文件系统状态，检查存储硬件健康。
advice_cn: 审计磁盘 IO 压力与文件系统状态，检查存储硬件健康。
advice_en: Audit disk IO pressure and verify storage hardware state.

title: NameNode metadata inconsistency
content: Block map update anomalies or redundant addStoredBlock requests.
advice: 核查 NameNode 元数据一致性与恢复状态，确认是否存在块状态漂移。
advice_cn: 核查 NameNode 元数据一致性与恢复状态，确认是否存在块状态漂移。
advice_en: Verify NameNode metadata consistency and replay state.

title: Suspicious SSH successful login
content: Accepted password or publickey login from a new host, unusual source IP, or suspicious account context.
advice: 核对登录用户、来源 IP、登录时段与后续命令活动，如非授权应立即锁定账号并阻断来源。
advice_cn: 核对登录用户、来源 IP、登录时段与后续命令活动，如非授权应立即锁定账号并阻断来源。
advice_en: Verify login user, source IP, login time, and post-login command activity; disable or lock the account if unauthorized.

title: Suspicious SSH session establishment
content: pam_unix(sshd:session) session opened events after risky authentication activity.
advice: 结合前序认证日志与会话内命令进行关联分析，重点核查是否存在横向移动痕迹。
advice_cn: 结合前序认证日志与会话内命令进行关联分析，重点核查是否存在横向移动痕迹。
advice_en: Correlate with preceding authentication logs and audit commands executed in the session; review lateral movement traces.

title: Privileged audit command execution
content: Linux audit EXECVE or related privileged events involving sudo, uid=0, or sensitive command chains.
advice: 重点审查 audit 轨迹、sudo 链路、特权二进制与敏感文件变更，并收紧 sudoers 与特权组权限。
advice_cn: 重点审查 audit 轨迹、sudo 链路、特权二进制与敏感文件变更，并收紧 sudoers 与特权组权限。
advice_en: Review audit trail, sudo chain, privileged binaries, and sensitive file changes; tighten sudoers and privileged group membership.

title: Restricted web resource probing
content: Apache errors such as AH01630 or denied-by-configuration indicating probing of restricted paths.
advice: 检查被请求资源路径，收紧 Apache/WAF 规则，并对探测客户端实施限速或封禁。
advice_cn: 检查被请求资源路径，收紧 Apache/WAF 规则，并对探测客户端实施限速或封禁。
advice_en: Inspect requested paths, tighten Apache or WAF rules, and rate-limit or block probing clients.

title: Web scanner fingerprint activity
content: WPScan, Nmap NSE, or similar scanner fingerprints in access logs targeting admin paths or plugins.
advice: 封禁或限速扫描源 IP，检查暴露的管理路径与插件，并结合 WAF 或反向代理日志核对影响范围。
advice_cn: 封禁或限速扫描源 IP，检查暴露的管理路径与插件，并结合 WAF 或反向代理日志核对影响范围。
advice_en: Block or rate-limit scanner IPs, review exposed admin paths and plugins, and correlate with WAF or reverse proxy logs.

title: Content negotiation probing
content: Apache negotiation errors such as AH00687 that may indicate path discovery or malformed request probing.
advice: 核查可疑请求路径与扩展名，检查 Apache 协商配置，并追踪同一客户端的重复探测行为。
advice_cn: 核查可疑请求路径与扩展名，检查 Apache 协商配置，并追踪同一客户端的重复探测行为。
advice_en: Review suspicious request paths and file extensions, verify Apache content negotiation settings, and investigate repeated probing from the same client.

title: SSH excessive login attempts
content: Maximum login attempts exceeded or repeated authentication failures for privileged accounts.
advice: 封禁异常来源，检查被针对账号，并为暴露身份启用登录失败锁定或 MFA。
advice_cn: 封禁异常来源，检查被针对账号，并为暴露身份启用登录失败锁定或 MFA。
advice_en: Block the offending source, inspect targeted accounts, and enable account lockout or MFA for exposed identities.

title: SSH root login success
content: Accepted password or publickey login for root or another privileged account from an unusual source.
advice: 立即核查特权账号登录合法性，轮换可疑凭据，并审计登录后的命令执行与会话行为。
advice_cn: 立即核查特权账号登录合法性，轮换可疑凭据，并审计登录后的命令执行与会话行为。
advice_en: Immediately verify the legitimacy of the privileged login, rotate exposed credentials, and review commands executed after login.

title: SSH service account successful login
content: Accepted password login for deploy, backup, db_admin, admin, or other service-like accounts from unusual sources or time windows.
advice: 核对服务账号归属、来源 IP、登录时段与后续命令，如不符合预期应暂停该账号并进一步核查。
advice_cn: 核对服务账号归属、来源 IP、登录时段与后续命令，如不符合预期应暂停该账号并进一步核查。
advice_en: Verify the service account owner, source IP, login time window, and follow-up commands; suspend the account if the login is not expected.

title: SSH publickey login from unusual source
content: Accepted publickey authentication from a new host, unusual subnet, or unexpected service account context.
advice: 检查 authorized_keys、来源网段与账号历史行为，吊销可疑密钥并核查横向移动痕迹。
advice_cn: 检查 authorized_keys、来源网段与账号历史行为，吊销可疑密钥并核查横向移动痕迹。
advice_en: Check authorized_keys, source subnet, and account history; revoke suspicious keys and review lateral movement traces.

title: SSH disconnect churn after authentication
content: Frequent disconnect, reset, or short-lived SSH sessions after authentication attempts, suggesting enumeration or unstable brute force tooling.
advice: 将异常断连与相邻认证失败、成功登录事件关联分析，识别工具指纹，并对来源主机实施限速。
advice_cn: 将异常断连与相邻认证失败、成功登录事件关联分析，识别工具指纹，并对来源主机实施限速。
advice_en: Correlate disconnects with nearby failed and successful logins, inspect tooling fingerprints, and throttle the source host.

title: SSH account probing and user enumeration
content: user unknown, invalid user, check pass, or similar SSH traces indicating username enumeration or early-stage credential probing.
advice: 核查未知用户名、来源 IP 与探测频率，识别账号枚举来源，并在暴力破解升级前对探测主机实施限速或封禁。
advice_cn: 核查未知用户名、来源 IP 与探测频率，识别账号枚举来源，并在暴力破解升级前对探测主机实施限速或封禁。
advice_en: Review unknown usernames and source IP cadence, identify enumeration sources, and block or rate-limit probing hosts before brute-force escalation.

title: Web admin path enumeration
content: Repeated access to /admin, /login, /wp-login.php, or management endpoints with probing behavior.
advice: 检查暴露的管理入口，强化认证与访问控制，并封禁高频探测客户端。
advice_cn: 检查暴露的管理入口，强化认证与访问控制，并封禁高频探测客户端。
advice_en: Review exposed admin endpoints, tighten authentication and access controls, and block aggressive probing clients.

title: Web login brute-force pattern
content: Repeated login attempts against application login endpoints with changing usernames, parameters, or source cadence.
advice: 启用登录限速、MFA 与账号锁定策略，并检查被针对用户与来源 IP 信誉。
advice_cn: 启用登录限速、MFA 与账号锁定策略，并检查被针对用户与来源 IP 信誉。
advice_en: Enable login throttling, MFA, and account lockout; review targeted users and originating IP reputation.

title: PHP script probing
content: script not found or unable to stat errors indicating direct probing of PHP scripts or upload paths.
advice: 核查被探测脚本路径、Referer 与 User-Agent，并封禁重复脚本枚举来源。
advice_cn: 核查被探测脚本路径、Referer 与 User-Agent，并封禁重复脚本枚举来源。
advice_en: Inspect probed script paths, review Referer and user agent, and block repeated script enumeration attempts.

title: Sensitive resource denial probing
content: 403, denied-by-configuration, or similar responses while probing restricted directories or files.
advice: 确认被探测资源是否本应开放，收紧虚拟主机规则，并保留来源证据用于追踪。
advice_cn: 确认被探测资源是否本应开放，收紧虚拟主机规则，并保留来源证据用于追踪。
advice_en: Confirm whether the requested resource should ever be reachable, tighten virtual host rules, and preserve source evidence.

title: Audit command execution chain
content: Audit records show chained command execution, shell spawning, or sensitive binary invocation from a privileged context.
advice: 还原父子进程链路，定位最初触发命令，并检查该链路引发的文件或账号变更。
advice_cn: 还原父子进程链路，定位最初触发命令，并检查该链路引发的文件或账号变更。
advice_en: Reconstruct parent-child process chains, identify initial trigger commands, and inspect file or account changes made by the chain.

title: Sensitive account file access in audit logs
content: Audit logs indicate access to passwd, shadow, sudoers, SSH keys, or related identity artifacts.
advice: 确认对 passwd、shadow、sudoers 或密钥文件的访问是否符合预期，并视情况轮换暴露凭据或密钥。
advice_cn: 确认对 passwd、shadow、sudoers 或密钥文件的访问是否符合预期，并视情况轮换暴露凭据或密钥。
advice_en: Validate whether the access was expected, review the accessing process and user, and rotate exposed credentials or keys if needed.

title: Sudo chain anomaly
content: Sudo-related logs indicate unusual privilege escalation cadence, sensitive commands, or unexpected accounts using sudo.
advice: 审计 sudoers 配置、确认命令合法性，并核查该账号在当前时段是否应具备提权权限。
advice_cn: 审计 sudoers 配置、确认命令合法性，并核查该账号在当前时段是否应具备提权权限。
advice_en: Audit sudoers entries, confirm command legitimacy, and review whether the account should hold elevated privileges at that time.

title: OpenVPN remote access establishment
content: OpenVPN peer connection initiated events from unusual peers, networks, or service accounts.
advice: 核查对端身份、证书使用情况、连接时段与后续主机行为，必要时吊销可疑证书。
advice_cn: 核查对端身份、证书使用情况、连接时段与后续主机行为，必要时吊销可疑证书。
advice_en: Verify peer identity, certificate usage, connection time window, and subsequent host activity; revoke suspicious certificates if needed.

title: OpenVPN reconnect churn
content: Repeated OpenVPN connect-disconnect cycles that may indicate credential abuse, unstable tunneling tools, or probing.
advice: 将重复重连与认证结果、对端 IP 变化和隧道活动关联分析，必要时临时封禁来源。
advice_cn: 将重复重连与认证结果、对端 IP 变化和隧道活动关联分析，必要时临时封禁来源。
advice_en: Correlate reconnect cycles with authentication results, peer IP changes, and tunnel activity; consider temporary source blocking.

title: Apache malformed request spray
content: A burst of malformed HTTP requests, uncommon verbs, or invalid protocol combinations targeting the same host.
advice: 检查异常请求变体，确认是否针对已知解析弱点，并优化反向代理或 WAF 规则。
advice_cn: 检查异常请求变体，确认是否针对已知解析弱点，并优化反向代理或 WAF 规则。
advice_en: Inspect request variants, confirm whether they target a known parser weakness, and tune reverse proxy or WAF signatures.

title: Web error trigger after scanner probe
content: Web error logs spike shortly after scanning or probing traffic, suggesting the scanner is now hitting executable paths or weak handlers.
advice: 按客户端与时间关联访问日志和错误日志，定位最早触发异常的端点，并验证是否存在脆弱处理器。
advice_cn: 按客户端与时间关联访问日志和错误日志，定位最早触发异常的端点，并验证是否存在脆弱处理器。
advice_en: Correlate access and error logs by client and timestamp, identify the first failing endpoint, and validate whether a vulnerable handler exists.

title: Prompt injection attempt against AI agent
content: Prompt injection, instruction override, jailbreak, or secret extraction attempts targeting an AI agent or LLM workflow.
advice: 保留原始 prompt 与上下文，隔离受影响的 AI agent 会话，检查提示词模板与工具权限，并为指令覆写、秘密提取等模式增加阻断规则。
advice_cn: 保留原始 prompt 与上下文，隔离受影响的 AI agent 会话，检查提示词模板与工具权限，并为指令覆写、秘密提取等模式增加阻断规则。
advice_en: Preserve the original prompt content, isolate the affected agent session, review prompt templates and tool permissions, and add deny rules for instruction override or secret exfiltration patterns.

title: SSH brute force
content: Many failed password or invalid user events in a short time window.
advice: 限制高风险来源 IP，启用 MFA，并审计弱口令账号与暴力破解来源。
advice_cn: 限制高风险来源 IP，启用 MFA，并审计弱口令账号与暴力破解来源。
advice_en: Limit source IP, enable MFA, and audit weak credentials.

title: WebShell upload or execution signal
content: Web access or error logs show suspicious upload paths, webshell-like filenames, command parameters, or server-side script execution from writable directories.
advice: 隔离可疑文件并保留访问/错误日志，核查上传接口、目录权限与 Web 服务账号后续命令执行痕迹。
advice_cn: 隔离可疑文件并保留访问/错误日志，核查上传接口、目录权限与 Web 服务账号后续命令执行痕迹。
advice_en: Quarantine the suspected file, preserve access and error logs, verify upload handlers and file permissions, and hunt for follow-up command execution from the web server account.

title: Command injection through web request
content: HTTP parameters contain command separators, shell metacharacters, curl, wget, bash, sh, nc, or encoded command payloads consistent with command injection attempts.
advice: 定位可疑接口，将访问日志与进程执行、出站连接关联分析，阻断来源并复核受影响路由的输入处理逻辑。
advice_cn: 定位可疑接口，将访问日志与进程执行、出站连接关联分析，阻断来源并复核受影响路由的输入处理逻辑。
advice_en: Identify the vulnerable endpoint, correlate access logs with process execution and outbound traffic, block the source, and validate input handling on the affected route.

title: Suspicious file download by server process
content: Audit or process logs show wget, curl, python, perl, or shell tools downloading scripts, binaries, or payloads into temporary or web-writable directories.
advice: 保留下载文件哈希，阻断目标域名或 IP，审查发起进程树，并排查下载后的执行与持久化行为。
advice_cn: 保留下载文件哈希，阻断目标域名或 IP，审查发起进程树，并排查下载后的执行与持久化行为。
advice_en: Preserve the downloaded artifact hash, block the destination domain or IP, inspect the launching process tree, and search for execution or persistence after download.

title: Outbound C2 beaconing pattern
content: Repeated outbound connections, DNS queries, or HTTP requests with regular cadence, unusual user agents, rare domains, or small periodic payloads.
advice: 结合目标信誉、连接周期、进程归属和 DNS 历史进行研判；如确认为异常信标，应隔离主机并保留流量证据。
advice_cn: 结合目标信誉、连接周期、进程归属和 DNS 历史进行研判；如确认为异常信标，应隔离主机并保留流量证据。
advice_en: Correlate destination reputation, connection periodicity, process owner, and DNS history; isolate the host if the beacon is unauthorized.

title: Data exfiltration over web or DNS
content: Logs show abnormal outbound transfer volume, long encoded query strings, repeated POST uploads, archive downloads, or unusual DNS query length from a sensitive host.
advice: 定位传输对象与目标地址，保留代理/DNS 日志，停用相关账号或进程，并核查传输前是否访问敏感文件。
advice_cn: 定位传输对象与目标地址，保留代理/DNS 日志，停用相关账号或进程，并核查传输前是否访问敏感文件。
advice_en: Identify transferred objects and destination, preserve proxy or DNS logs, disable the involved account or process, and verify whether sensitive files were accessed before transfer.

title: Lateral movement through SSH or remote service
content: A host initiates SSH, VPN, SMB, RDP, or service-login activity to multiple internal systems shortly after suspicious authentication or privilege activity.
advice: 梳理源账号与目标主机，关联认证链路，吊销可疑凭据，并排查密钥复制或远程命令执行痕迹。
advice_cn: 梳理源账号与目标主机，关联认证链路，吊销可疑凭据，并排查密钥复制或远程命令执行痕迹。
advice_en: Map the source account and target hosts, inspect authentication chains, revoke exposed credentials, and hunt for copied keys or remote command execution.

title: SSH key tampering or unauthorized key addition
content: Audit logs indicate writes to authorized_keys, sshd_config, known_hosts, or SSH key files by an unexpected process or account.
advice: 检查 SSH 配置和密钥文件变更、属主与差异，移除未授权密钥，轮换受影响凭据，并关联前序可疑登录。
advice_cn: 检查 SSH 配置和密钥文件变更、属主与差异，移除未授权密钥，轮换受影响凭据，并关联前序可疑登录。
advice_en: Review file diff and ownership, remove unauthorized keys, rotate affected credentials, and check whether the change followed a suspicious login.

title: Cron or systemd persistence change
content: Audit or system logs show unexpected creation or modification of crontab, systemd service, rc.local, init script, or timer units.
advice: 停用可疑计划任务或服务，保留 unit/脚本内容与命令目标，并追踪创建该持久化项的用户或进程。
advice_cn: 停用可疑计划任务或服务，保留 unit/脚本内容与命令目标，并追踪创建该持久化项的用户或进程。
advice_en: Disable suspicious scheduled tasks or services, preserve unit files and command targets, and trace the user or process that created the persistence entry.

title: Credential dumping or secret discovery
content: Audit or shell activity references shadow, passwd, id_rsa, credential files, token files, browser secrets, environment dumps, or config files containing keys.
advice: 保留进程与文件访问证据，轮换暴露密钥或凭据，搜索压缩打包与外传行为，并复核最小权限控制。
advice_cn: 保留进程与文件访问证据，轮换暴露密钥或凭据，搜索压缩打包与外传行为，并复核最小权限控制。
advice_en: Preserve process and file access evidence, rotate exposed secrets, search for archive or exfiltration activity, and validate least-privilege controls.

title: Log tampering or audit trail deletion
content: Audit or shell logs show deletion, truncation, permission changes, or service stops affecting auth.log, audit.log, web logs, bash history, or security telemetry.
advice: 保留残余日志并与远程采集端比对，定位篡改账号和进程，使用独立遥测重建事件时间线。
advice_cn: 保留残余日志并与远程采集端比对，定位篡改账号和进程，使用独立遥测重建事件时间线。
advice_en: Preserve remaining logs, compare with remote collectors, identify the account and process performing tampering, and rebuild the timeline from independent telemetry.

title: Suspicious archive staging before transfer
content: Commands or audit events show tar, zip, gzip, 7z, or archive creation over web roots, home directories, configuration folders, or sensitive data paths.
advice: 检查压缩包内容，关联后续网络传输，保留文件元数据，并判断是否为敏感数据外传前的暂存。
advice_cn: 检查压缩包内容，关联后续网络传输，保留文件元数据，并判断是否为敏感数据外传前的暂存。
advice_en: Inspect archive contents, correlate with later network transfer, preserve file metadata, and determine whether sensitive data was staged for exfiltration.

title: Apache path traversal or file disclosure probe
content: Web requests include ../ traversal, encoded traversal, passwd, shadow, proc, env, backup files, or configuration file disclosure probes.
advice: 复核请求路径与响应码，验证路径规范化和静态文件处理，阻断来源，并确认是否返回了敏感文件。
advice_cn: 复核请求路径与响应码，验证路径规范化和静态文件处理，阻断来源，并确认是否返回了敏感文件。
advice_en: Review requested paths and response codes, verify canonicalization and static file handling, block the source, and check whether sensitive files were returned.

title: VPN credential abuse or impossible travel
content: OpenVPN or remote access logs show the same identity connecting from unusual countries, new ASN ranges, overlapping sessions, or rapid reconnects after failures.
advice: 核实用户合法性，对比地理位置和 ASN 历史，吊销或轮换证书/密码，并审查 VPN 建立后的内网活动。
advice_cn: 核实用户合法性，对比地理位置和 ASN 历史，吊销或轮换证书/密码，并审查 VPN 建立后的内网活动。
advice_en: Verify user legitimacy, compare geo and ASN history, revoke or rotate the certificate or password, and inspect internal activity after VPN establishment.

title: DNS tunneling or encoded domain pattern
content: DNS logs contain unusually long labels, high-entropy subdomains, repeated NXDOMAIN responses, rare domains, or query bursts from a single host.
advice: 分析查询熵值与目标信誉，疑似隧道时隔离源主机，并关联进程、代理和网络遥测。
advice_cn: 分析查询熵值与目标信誉，疑似隧道时隔离源主机，并关联进程、代理和网络遥测。
advice_en: Analyze query entropy and destination reputation, isolate the source if tunneling is suspected, and correlate with process and proxy telemetry.

title: Container or service account abuse
content: Audit logs show service accounts, container runtimes, or web server users invoking privileged binaries, mounting paths, changing capabilities, or accessing host secrets.
advice: 核查运行时权限、挂载路径、服务账号范围与主机文件访问；如存在越界提权，应隔离相关工作负载。
advice_cn: 核查运行时权限、挂载路径、服务账号范围与主机文件访问；如存在越界提权，应隔离相关工作负载。
advice_en: Review runtime permissions, mounted paths, service account scope, and host file access; isolate the workload if privilege boundaries were crossed.
